text:
Priya: Marigold Therapeutics just emailed AE2D they need a focused FedRAMP + migration runbook review this morning. Prefer a short handson workshop (40m) to validate timeline risk. Can we move the 2pm office hour?
Jordan: We can do a morning slot. What's their preferred window?
Marigold_CISO: (external) Morning PT best: 09:30 or 10:30. Need sandbox walkthrough + migration checklist. 
Sam: I can run the demo but need someone for the compliance Q&A. Leah available?
Leah: Yes I can handle FedRAMP Q&A and run through the migration lift checklist. 10:30 PT works for me.
Priya: Okay let's aim for 10:30 PT. @cs_scheduler_bot can you create invite "Marigold - FedRAMP workshop & migration runbook" at 10:30 PT and add Marigold_CISO, infra@marigold.com, and our solutions alias?
cs_scheduler_bot: Creating event... ✅ Invite created: https://cal.redwood.com/event/marigold-fedramp-1744007777 (10:30 PT / 17:30 UTC). Reminders: 30m and 10m.
Jordan: Draft agenda: 
```
10:30 - 10:35 Goals + success criteria (Priya)
10:35 - 10:55 Live demo: hosted baseline & KMS options (Sam)
10:55 - 11:05 Migration runbook + timeline Qs (Leah)
11:05 - 11:10 Next steps & owners (Mark)
```
Mark: I'll capture owners and any renewal signals. If they ask for extended SLAs or onprem timelines, flag as "renewal-risk" and tag AE.
Sam: Sandbox needs scrubbed data. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sandbox-scrub. I can scrub and snapshot, give me 25m.
Leah: I'll prep a 1pager migration checklist + a short FAQ for airgap vs VPC options. Dropping in chat during call.
Priya: Also we should run a 2question pulse after: (1) Was the migration plan actionable? (Y/N) (2) Confidence to hit target date (15). Add score to account health.
Marigold_CISO: (external) Thanks  confirmed 10:30 PT. A short preread would be helpful.
Jordan: I'll share preread (2 slides) and the target migration timeline example.
Mark: Who owns followups? I'll take postcall notes and create tickets for any technical blockers.
Sam: Recording OK? I will record the demo and upload clips to the event doc with timestamps.
Priya: Precall quick sync at 10:00 DM huddle. Can Sam, Leah, Mark join?
Leah: Yes 10:00 is good.
cs_scheduler_bot: Event updated by Jordan. Email invites resent. Reminder scheduled.
Marigold_CISO: (external) Appreciate the quick turn. We'll join the precall if possible.
Mark: After call I'll add "renewal-risk" tags to account health if they request onprem timelines > 3 months or extended SLA.
Sam: Snapshot uploaded: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/marigold-snap-1744007777 (PII scrubbed).
Priya: Great. See you all at 10:00 precall. :thumbsup:
